mainEntity.name: What services does Adapt Halton Alcohol and Drugs offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adapt Halton Alcohol and Drugs offers a range of comprehensive assessment and treatment services to individuals and families who are struggling with substance abuse, drug addiction, alcoholism, and gambling addiction. They also offer presentations on alcohol consumption, drug consumption, and gambling on a limited basis.

mainEntity.name: Is Adapt Halton Alcohol and Drugs a non-profit organization?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Adapt Halton Alcohol and Drugs is a non-profit, community-based, outpatient addiction agency funded by various government agencies, including the Ministry of Health & Long Term Care, the Ministry of Children and Youth Services, and the Ministry of Community Safety and Correctional Services, and the United Way.

mainEntity.name: What age group does Adapt Halton Alcohol and Drugs serve?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adapt Halton Alcohol and Drugs offers services for youths aged 24 and under who are affected by substance or alcohol use. They also provide ongoing counseling and support to adults who are struggling with their own substance use.

mainEntity.name: What types of addiction does Adapt Halton Alcohol and Drugs treat?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adapt Halton Alcohol and Drugs specializes in treating individuals who are struggling with substance abuse, drug addiction, alcoholism, and gambling addiction.

mainEntity.name: What types of therapies does Adapt Halton Alcohol and Drugs offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adapt Halton Alcohol and Drugs offers a variety of therapies, including holistic therapy, evidence-based practices, yoga, meditation, individual therapy, family therapy, group therapy, nutritional counseling, art therapy, and nature therapy.

mainEntity.name: Is there a cost for Adapt Halton Alcohol and Drugs services?

acceptedAnswer.text: The presentations provided by Adapt Halton Alcohol and Drugs are free of charge. Their other services may be covered by insurance or government-funded programs, and they also offer sliding scale fees for those who do not have insurance or cannot afford to pay.

mainEntity.name: Where is Adapt Halton Alcohol and Drugs located?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adapt Halton Alcohol and Drugs is located in Acton, Ontario.

about_blocks.text: ADAPT is a non-profit, community-based, outpatient addiction agency that offers a range of services throughout the Halton Region. The center is funded by the Ministry of Health & Long Term Care, the Ministry of Children and Youth Services, the Ministry of Community Safety and Correctional Services, and the United Way. Their services include drug addiction treatment, alcohol addiction treatment, gambling addiction treatment, and more.

The center is funded by the Ministry of Health & Long Term Care, the Ministry of Children and Youth Services, the Ministry of Community Safety and Correctional Services, and the United Way. Their services include drug addiction treatment, alcohol addiction treatment, gambling addiction treatment, and more.

about_blocks.text: ADAPT provides programs for youths aged 24 and under who are affected by substance or alcohol use. They also offer concurrent disorders treatment to those in need. Additionally, their addiction counselors provide ongoing counseling and support to adults struggling with their own substance use. Adult programs include drug addiction treatment, alcohol addiction treatment, and addictions supportive housing.
